# SAS Script: CPRD Data Import

## 1. Options and macro variables

```sas
options symbolgen mprint mlogic;

%let prefix = RA_shahab_Extract_;
%let suffix = ;
```

- `options symbolgen mprint mlogic`: Enables macro debugging (prints variable values, generated code, and logic flow to log).
- `%let prefix = ...`: Defines a macro variable for the file name prefix.
- `&datafolder.` is an external macro variable (assumed set earlier) pointing to the root data directory.

---

## 2. Patient data

```sas
data patient;
	infile "&datafolder.\txt\&prefix.Patient_001.txt" dsd dlm='09'x firstobs=2 truncover;
		input patid vmid gender yob mob marital famnum chsreg chsdate : ddmmyy10. prescr capsup 
		  frd : ddmmyy10. crd : ddmmyy10. regstat reggap internal tod : ddmmyy10.  toreason deathdate : ddmmyy10.  accept;
	format  frd ddmmyy10. crd ddmmyy10. chsdate ddmmyy10. tod ddmmyy10. deathdate ddmmyy10.;
run;
```

Reads single file `Patient_001.txt` into dataset `patient`. Tab-delimited (`dlm='09'x`), skips header (`firstobs=2`). Date variables use `: ddmmyy10.` informat. `format` applies date formats for display.

---

## 3. Clinical data setup and import

```sas
%let max_clin = 2;

data clinical;
			  format patid best12. ;
	          format eventdate $10. ;
	          format sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
	          format constype best12. ;
	          format consid best12. ;
	          format medcode best12. ;
	          format staffid best12. ;
	          format episode best12. ;
	          format enttype best12. ;
	          format adid best12. ;
			  delete;
run;

%macro readclinical;
%do i = 1 %to &max_clin.; 
		%if &i. < 10 %then %do; 
	data RAW_DATA.CLINICAL00&i.;
	       %let _EFIERR_ = 0;
	       infile "&datafolder.\txt\&prefix.Clinical_00&i..txt" delimiter='09'x MISSOVER DSD lrecl=32767 firstobs=2 ;
	          informat patid best32. ;
	          informat eventdate $10. ;
	          informat sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
	          informat constype best32. ;
	          informat consid best32. ;
	          informat medcode best32. ;
	          informat staffid best32. ;
	          informat episode best32. ;
	          informat enttype best32. ;
	          informat adid best32. ;
	          format patid best12. ;
	          format eventdate $10. ;
	          format sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
	          format constype best12. ;
	          format consid best12. ;
	          format medcode best12. ;
	          format staffid best12. ;
	          format episode best12. ;
	          format enttype best12. ;
	          format adid best12. ;
	       input
	                   patid
	                   eventdate $
	                   sysdate
	                   constype
	                   consid
	                   medcode
	                   staffid
	                   episode
	                   enttype
	                   adid
	       ;
	if _ERROR_ then call symputx('_EFIERR_',1);
	run;
%end;
proc append base=clinical data=RAW_DATA.CLINICAL00&i.;
run;
proc datasets library=raw_data;
delete CLINICAL00&i.;
quit;
%end;
%mend;

%readclinical;
```

Creates empty `clinical` dataset with formats. Macro loops `i=1` to `&max_clin`, imports each numbered clinical file, and appends to base. Temporary datasets are deleted after append.

## 4. Additional data

```sas
%let max_add = 1;

data additional;
			format patid best12. ;
       		format enttype best12. ;
			format adid best12. ;
         	format data1 $12. ;
         	format data2 $12. ;
         	format data3 $12. ;
         	format data4 $12. ;
         	format data5 $12. ;
         	format data6 $12. ;
         	format data7 $12. ;
			delete;
run;

%macro readadditional;
%do i = 1 %to &max_add.; 
		%if &i. < 10 %then %do; 
	data RAW_DATA.ADDITIONAL00&i.;
	       %let _EFIERR_ = 0;
	       infile "&datafolder.\txt\&prefix.Additional_00&i..txt" delimiter='09'x MISSOVER DSD lrecl=32767 firstobs=2 ;
         informat patid best12. ;
         informat enttype best12. ;
         informat adid best12. ;
         informat data1 $12. ;
         informat data2 $12. ;
         informat data3 $12. ;
         informat data4 $12. ;
         informat data5 $12. ;
         informat data6 $12. ;
         informat data7 $12. ;
         format patid best12. ;
         format enttype best12. ;
         format adid best12. ;
         format data1 $12. ;
         format data2 $12. ;
         format data3 $12. ;
         format data4 $12. ;
         format data5 $12. ;
         format data6 $12. ;
         format data7 $12. ;
      input
                  patid
                  enttype
                  adid
                  data1 $
                  data2 $
                  data3 $
                  data4 $
                  data5 $
                  data6 $
                  data7 $
      ;
      if _ERROR_ then call symputx('_EFIERR_',1);
      run;
%end;
proc append base=Additional data=RAW_DATA.Additional00&i.;
run;
proc datasets library=raw_data;
delete Additional00&i.;
quit;
%end;
%mend;

%readadditional;
```

Creates empty `additional` dataset with seven free-text fields (`data1`–`data7`). Macro imports `Additional_001.txt` and appends. Similar structure to clinical but only one file.

## 6. Test data

```sas
%let max_tst = 6;
data test;
		 format patid best12. ;
         format eventdate $10. ;
         format sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
         format constype best12. ;

         format medcode best12. ;

         format data4 best12. ;
         format data5 best12. ;
         format data6 best12. ;
         format data7 best12. ;
		 format data8 best12. ;
   		 delete;
run;

%macro readtest;
%do i = 1 %to &max_tst.; 
		%if &i. < 10 %then %do;
    data RAW_DATA.TEST00&i    ;
      	%let _EFIERR_ = 0;
      	infile "&datafolder.\txt\&prefix.Test_00&i..txt" delimiter='09'x MISSOVER DSD lrecl=32767 firstobs=2 ;
         informat patid best32. ;
         informat eventdate $10. ;
         informat sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
         informat constype best32. ;
         informat consid best32. ;
         informat medcode best32. ;
         informat staffid best32. ;
         informat enttype best32. ;
         informat data1 best32. ;
         informat data2 best32. ;
         informat data3 best32. ;
         informat data4 best32. ;
         informat data5 best32. ;
         informat data6 best32. ;
         informat data7 best32. ;
		 informat data8 best32. ;
         format patid best12. ;
         format eventdate $10. ;
         format sysdate ddmmyy10. ;
         format constype best12. ;
         format consid best12. ;
         format medcode best12. ;
         format staffid best12. ;
         format enttype best12. ;
         format data1 best12. ;
         format data2 best12. ;
         format data3 best12. ;
         format data4 best12. ;
         format data5 best12. ;
         format data6 best12. ;
         format data7 best12. ;
		 format data8 best12. ;
      input
                  patid
                  eventdate $
                  sysdate
                  constype
                  consid
                  medcode
                  staffid
                  enttype
                  data1
                  data2
                  data3
                  data4
                  data5
                  data6

				  data8
```

Creates empty `test` dataset with eight numeric result fields (`data1`–`data8`). Macro loops through 6 test files (Test_001.txt through Test_006.txt), imports each, and appends.

## 7. Therapy data

```sas
%let max_ther = 9;

data therapy;
		informat patid best32. ;
		informat eventdate $10. ;
		informat sysdate $10. ;
		informat consid best32. ;
		informat prodcode best32. ;
		informat staffid best32. ;
		informat dosageid $64. ;
		informat bnfcode best32. ;
		informat qty best32. ;
		informat numdays best32. ;
		informat numpacks best32. ;
		informat packtype best32. ;
		informat issueseq best32. ;
		format patid best12. ;
		format eventdate $10. ;
		format sysdate $10. ;
		format consid best12. ;
		format prodcode best12. ;
		format staffid best12. ;
		format dosageid $64. ;
		format bnfcode best12. ;
		format qty best12. ;
		format numdays best12. ;
		format numpacks best12. ;
		format packtype best12. ;
		format issueseq best12. ;
   		 delete;
run;

%macro readtherapy;
%do i = 1 %to &max_ther.; 
		%if &i. < 10 %then %do;
    data RAW_DATA.THERAPY00&i    ;
      	%let _EFIERR_ = 0;
      	infile "&datafolder.\txt\&prefix.Therapy_00&i..txt" delimiter='09'x MISSOVER DSD lrecl=32767 firstobs=2 ;
        	informat patid best32. ;
			informat eventdate $10. ;
			informat sysdate $10. ;
			informat consid best32. ;
			informat prodcode best32. ;
			informat staffid best32. ;
			informat dosageid $64. ;
			informat bnfcode best32. ;
			informat qty best32. ;
			informat numdays best32. ;
			informat numpacks best32. ;
			informat packtype best32. ;
			informat issueseq best32. ;
			format patid best12. ;
			format eventdate $10. ;
			format sysdate $10. ;
			format consid best12. ;
			format prodcode best12. ;
			format staffid best12. ;
			format dosageid $64. ;
			format bnfcode best12. ;
			format qty best12. ;
			format numdays best12. ;
			format numpacks best12. ;
			format packtype best12. ;
			format issueseq best12. ;
	input
			patid
			eventdate $
			sysdate $
			consid
			prodcode
			staffid
			dosageid $
			bnfcode
			qty
			numdays
			numpacks
			packtype
			issueseq
      ;
      if _ERROR_ then call symputx('_EFIERR_',1);
run;
%end;
proc append base=therapy data=RAW_DATA.Therapy00&i.;
run;
proc datasets library=raw_data;
delete Therapy00&i.;
quit;
%end;
%mend;

%readtherapy;
```

Creates empty `therapy` dataset with prescription fields (product codes, quantity, days supplied). Macro loops through 9 therapy files (Therapy_001.txt through Therapy_009.txt), imports each, and appends. Note dates stored as strings (`$10.`), not SAS dates.

## 8. Practice data

```sas
Data raw_data.practice;
 infile "&datafolder.\TXT\&prefix.Practice_001.txt" dsd dlm='09'x firstobs=2 truncover;
 input pracid region lcd : ddmmyy10. uts : ddmmyy10.   ;
 format lcd ddmmyy10. uts ddmmyy10. ;
run;
```

Reads single file `Practice_001.txt` directly into permanent `raw_data.practice` dataset. Contains practice ID, region, and two dates (last collection date, up-to-standard date).

---

## 9. Final dataset moves and combinations

```sas
data raw_data.patient;
set patient; 
run;

data raw_data.referral;
set referral;
run;

data raw_data.clinical;
set clinical;
run;

data raw_data.test;
set test;
run;

data raw_data.additional;
set additional;
run;

data raw_data.therapy;
set therapy;
run;

Data clinical_all;
Set raw_data.clinical raw_data.referral;
run;

Data raw_data.Clinical_all;
set clinical_all;
run;

Data clinical_total;
Set clinical_all raw_data.test;
run;

Data raw_data.Clinical_total;
set clinical_total;
run;
```

Moves all temporary datasets into permanent `raw_data` library. Then combines clinical and referral into `clinical_all`, and adds test data to create `clinical_total` (a unified clinical events dataset).

---

## 10. Contents checks

```sas
proc contents
data =raw_data.clinical;
run;

proc contents
data =raw_data.patient;
run;

proc contents
data =raw_data.additional;
run;

proc contents
data =raw_data.test;
run;

proc contents
data =raw_data.therapy;
run;

proc contents
data =raw_data.referral;
run;
```

`proc contents` prints variable metadata (names, types, formats, labels) for each final dataset — a quick quality check to confirm imports worked correctly.
